g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS01 Opening the 3D Kitchen Viewer inside the SPA
The viewer is rendered INSIDE the common layout (WEB02). WEB06 owns the endpoint, the JSON format
and the viewer contract (usWEB06 3.4.5); VIS01 implements the viewer and its states.
Every error branch ENDS the interaction: no partial scene, no previous scene, no embedded layout.
401 / 403 are handled ONCE by WEB03 (Table B) inside ModuleRequest before VIS01 sees the error.
Engine failures (renderer, build, update, render, context loss): sequence_diagram_engine_failure.
